/* ManifestMapper.selectMasterInList : 적하목록 Master In List */ SET TRANSACTION ISOLATION LEVEL READ UNCOMMITTED;
SELECT B.* FROM (
SELECT
(SELECT NAME_${userLanguage} FROM TB_SMS_CODE_DETAIL WHERE ENT_CODE = od.ENT_CODE AND GROUP_CODE = 'STATUS_ORDER_CARGO' AND CODE = MAX(CASE WHEN ad.LAST_POD_STATUS IN ('ECM060','ECM055','ECM100','ECM110','ECM115','ECM120','ECM130','ECM143','ECM240') THEN ad.LAST_POD_STATUS ELSE '' END )) AS LAST_POD_STATUS
(SELECT NAME_${userLanguage} FROM TB_SMS_CODE_DETAIL WHERE ENT_CODE = od.ENT_CODE AND GROUP_CODE = 'STATUS_ORDER_CARGO' AND CODE = MAX(ad.LAST_POD_STATUS)) AS LAST_POD_STATUS
MAX(CASE WHEN ad.LAST_POD_STATUS IN ('ECM060','ECM055','ECM100','ECM110','ECM115','ECM120','ECM130','ECM143','ECM240') THEN ad.LAST_POD_STATUS ELSE '' END ) AS LAST_POD_STATUS
MAX(ad.LAST_POD_STATUS) AS LAST_POD_STATUS
,(SELECT COUNT(OD_JOB_NO) FROM TB_ECM_OD WHERE MASTER_OD_JOB_NO = od.MASTER_OD_JOB_NO AND BL_TYPE_MH = 'H') AS HOUSE_COUNT_ALL ,MIN(od.OD_JOB_NO) AS HOUSE_OD_JOB_NO
,MAX(od.SELECTOR_USER_NAME) AS SELECTOR_USER_NAME ,MAX(od.CONFIRMER_USER_NAME) AS CONFIRMER_USER_NAME
(SELECT NAME_${userLanguage} FROM TB_SMS_CODE_DETAIL WHERE ENT_CODE = od.ENT_CODE AND GROUP_CODE = 'STATUS_ORDER_CARGO' AND CODE = MAX(odAdd.LAST_POD_STATUS)) AS LAST_POD_STATUS
MAX(odAdd.LAST_POD_STATUS) AS LAST_POD_STATUS
,MAX(master.SELECTOR_USER_NAME) AS SELECTOR_USER_NAME ,MAX(master.CONFIRMER_USER_NAME) AS CONFIRMER_USER_NAME
,od.MASTER_OD_JOB_NO AS OD_JOB_NO ,(SELECT CUSTOMER_NAME FROM TB_SMS_CUSTOMER WHERE ENT_CODE = od.ENT_CODE AND CUSTOMER_CODE = MAX(master.CUST_CODE_LV1)) AS UPPER_CUS_NAME ,MAX(master.BOUND) AS BOUND ,MAX(master.BOUND_TYPE) AS BOUND_TYPE ,MAX(master.AR_DATE) AS AR_DATE ,MAX(master.OB_DATE) AS OB_DATE ,MAX(master.VESSEL_FLIGHT) AS VESSEL_FLIGHT ,MAX(master.ORIG_CODE) AS ORIG_CODE ,MAX(master.ORIG_NAME) AS ORIG_NAME ,MAX(master.DEST_CODE) AS DEST_CODE ,MAX(master.DEST_PORT) AS DEST_PORT ,MAX(master.MBL_NO) AS MBL_NO ,MAX(master.MRN) AS MRN ,MAX(master.MSN) AS MSN ,MAX(master.PO_NO) AS PO_NO ,MAX(master.PO_DATE) AS PO_DATE ,MAX(master.PIECES) AS PIECES ,MAX(master.GWT) AS GWT ,MAX(master.REMARKS) AS REMARKS ,MAX(ad.BUSINESS_FINISH_YN) AS BUSINESS_FINISH_YN ,MAX(master.DISC_WH_CODE) AS DISC_WH_CODE ,MAX(master.ASSIGNMENT_WH_CODE) AS ASSIGNMENT_WH_CODE ,MAX(ad.CLEARANCE_RECEIPT_DATE) AS CLEARANCE_RECEIPT_DATE ,MAX(od.ECM_YN) AS ECM_YN ,COUNT(CASE WHEN ISNULL(od.ECM_YN,'') = 'Y' THEN 1 END) AS ECM_Y_CNT ,COUNT(CASE WHEN ISNULL(od.ECM_YN,'') = '' OR od.ECM_YN = 'N' THEN 1 END) AS ECM_N_CNT ,SUM(od.CBM) AS CBM ,SUM(od.PIECES) AS HOUSE_PIECES ,SUM(od.GWT) AS HOUSE_GWT ,COUNT(od.OD_JOB_NO) AS HOUSE_COUNT ,COUNT(CASE WHEN ISNULL(ad.CFA_DATE,'') != '' THEN 1 END) AS CFA_SEND_CNT ,COUNT(CASE WHEN ISNULL(od.CD_TYPE,'') = 'Y' THEN 1 END) AS CD_TYPE1 ,COUNT(CASE WHEN ISNULL(od.CD_TYPE,'') = 'B' THEN 1 END) AS CD_TYPE2 ,COUNT(CASE WHEN ISNULL(od.CD_TYPE,'') = 'N' THEN 1 END) AS CD_TYPE3 ,COUNT(CASE WHEN ISNULL(od.CD_TYPE,'') = 'NA' THEN 1 END) AS CD_TYPE4 ,COUNT(CASE WHEN ISNULL(od.INSPECTION_YN, '') = 'Y' THEN 1 END) AS INSPECTION_YN ,COUNT(CASE WHEN ISNULL(ad.SE_INSPECTION_YN, '') = 'Y' THEN 1 END) AS SE_INSPECTION_YN ,COUNT(CASE WHEN ISNULL(ad.DROP_YN,'') = 'Y' THEN 1 END) AS DROP_YN ,COUNT(CASE WHEN ISNULL(ad.XRAY_YN,'') = 'Y' THEN 1 END) AS XRAY_YN ,COUNT(CASE WHEN ISNULL(ad.CRIME_SELECTION_YN,'') = 'Y' THEN 1 END) AS CRIME_SELECTION_YN ,COUNT(CASE WHEN ISNULL(od.GE_INSPECTION_YN,'') = 'Y' THEN 1 END) AS GE_INSPECTION_YN
, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM ( SELECT hod.OD_JOB_NO FROM TB_ECM_OD hod LEFT JOIN TB_ECM_OD_HOLD hld ON hod.OD_JOB_NO = hld.OD_JOB_NO WHERE hod.MASTER_OD_JOB_NO = od.MASTER_OD_JOB_NO AND hod.BL_TYPE_MH = MIN(od.BL_TYPE_MH) AND hld.HOLD_RELEASE_YN = 'N' GROUP BY hod.OD_JOB_NO ) A ) AS HOLD_YN ,COUNT(CASE WHEN ISNULL(od.INSPECTION_TYPE,'') != '' AND ISNULL(od.INSPECTION_TYPE,'') NOT IN ('8','10') THEN 1 END) AS INSPECTION_TYPE1 ,COUNT(CASE WHEN ISNULL(od.INSPECTION_TYPE,'') = '8' THEN 1 END) AS INSPECTION_TYPE2 ,COUNT(CASE WHEN ISNULL(od.INSPECTION_TYPE,'') = '10' THEN 1 END) AS INSPECTION_TYPE3 ,COUNT(CASE WHEN ISNULL(ad.SIMPLE_EDI_STATUS,'') = 'ERROR' THEN 1 END) AS SIMPLE_EDI_STATUS_ERROR ,(SELECT obl.OBL_JOB_NO FROM TB_COM_OD cod INNER JOIN TB_COM_OBL obl ON obl.OBL_JOB_NO = cod.OBL_JOB_NO WHERE cod.OD_JOB_NO = od.MASTER_OD_JOB_NO) AS OBL_JOB_NO ,(SELECT USER_NAME FROM TB_SMS_USER WHERE ENT_CODE = od.ENT_CODE AND USER_ID = MAX(master.REGISTER_USER_ID)) AS REGISTER_USER_NAME ,(SELECT USER_NAME FROM TB_SMS_USER WHERE ENT_CODE = od.ENT_CODE AND USER_ID = MAX(ad.BUSINESS_FINISH_USER_ID)) AS BUSINESS_FINISH_USER_NAME
,COUNT(abnormal.OD_JOB_NO) AS ABNORMAL_CNT
,SUM(CASE WHEN ad.CARRYIN_DATE IS NOT NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS CARRYIN_CNT ,SUM(CASE WHEN ad.CARRYIN_DATE IS NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS NOT_CARRYIN_CNT ,SUM(CASE WHEN ad.CARRYIN_DATE IS NOT NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END - CASE WHEN ad.CARRYOUT_DATE IS NOT NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS NOT_CARRYOUT_CNT
,CASE WHEN COUNT(*) <> 0 THEN ROUND((CONVERT(FLOAT,SUM(CASE WHEN ad.CARRYIN_DATE IS NOT NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END))/COUNT(*))*100, 2) ELSE 0 END AS CARRYIN_RATE ,MAX(ad.SIMPLE_EDI_STATUS) AS SIMPLE_EDI_STATUS ,CONCAT(MAX(ad.SIMPLE_DOC_DATE), ' ', MAX(ad.SIMPLE_DOC_TIME)) AS SIMPLE_DOC_DATE ,(SELECT CONCAT(POD_DATE,' ',POD_TIME) FROM TB_ECM_POD_02 tep WHERE POD_STATUS ='ECM130' AND tep.OD_JOB_NO = MAX(od.OD_JOB_NO)) AS SIMPLE_DOC_RESULT_DATE
,(SELECT max(SIMPLE_REPORT_DATE) FROM TB_ECM_OD_ADDITIONAL addi JOIN TB_ECM_OD odd ON addi.od_job_no = odd.od_job_no WHERE SIMPLE_DOC_NO = ad.simple_doc_no and odd.CD_TYPE = 'Y') as SIMPLE_REPORT_DATE
, ad.SIMPLE_DOC_NO
,ad.SIMPLE_DOC_NO
,MAX(odAdd.SIMPLE_DOC_NO) AS SIMPLE_DOC_NO
,( SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT(ISNULL(had.SIMPLE_DOC_NO,''))) FROM TB_ECM_OD hod INNER JOIN TB_ECM_OD_ADDITIONAL had ON had.OD_JOB_NO = hod.OD_JOB_NO WHERE hod.MASTER_OD_JOB_NO = od.MASTER_OD_JOB_NO AND hod.BL_TYPE_MH = 'H' ) AS SIMPLE_DOC_NO_CNT ,( SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT(had.SIMPLE_DOC_NO)) FROM TB_ECM_OD hod INNER JOIN TB_ECM_OD_ADDITIONAL had ON had.OD_JOB_NO = hod.OD_JOB_NO WHERE hod.MASTER_OD_JOB_NO = od.MASTER_OD_JOB_NO AND hod.BL_TYPE_MH = 'H' ) AS SIMPLE_DOC_NO_NOT_NULL_CNT
,MAX(odAdd.SIMPLE_DOC_NO) AS SIMPLE_DOC_NO ,COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN ISNULL(ad.SIMPLE_DOC_NO,'') = '' THEN 'NULL' ELSE ad.SIMPLE_DOC_NO END) AS SIMPLE_DOC_NO_CNT ,COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN ad.SIMPLE_DOC_NO = '' THEN NULL ELSE ad.SIMPLE_DOC_NO END) AS SIMPLE_DOC_NO_NOT_NULL_CNT
,COUNT(CASE WHEN ad.PACKING_ERROR_YN = 'Y' THEN 1 END) AS PACKING_CNT ,COUNT(CASE WHEN od.CD_TYPE = 'Y' AND ISNULL(ad.SIMPLE_DOC_NO,'') = '' THEN 1 END) AS WAIT_CNT
,ISNULL(SUM(pod.CNT1),0) as POD_CNT
FROM TB_ECM_OD od
WITH (INDEX(TB_ECM_OD_X02))
LEFT JOIN TB_ECM_OD_ADDITIONAL ad
ON od.OD_JOB_NO = ad.OD_JOB_NO LEFT JOIN TB_ECM_OD master ON master.OD_JOB_NO = od.MASTER_OD_JOB_NO LEFT JOIN TB_ECM_OD_ADDITIONAL odAdd ON master.OD_JOB_NO = odAdd.OD_JOB_NO
LEFT JOIN TB_ECM_OD_ABNORMAL abnormal ON abnormal.OD_JOB_No = od.OD_JOB_NO AND abnormal.SEQ_NO_ID = 1
LEFT JOIN ( SELECT OD_JOB_NO , COUNT(1) AS CNT1 FROM TB_ECM_POD_02 WHERE POD_STATUS = 'ECM143' GROUP BY OD_JOB_NO ) pod ON od.OD_JOB_NO = pod.OD_JOB_NO
GROUP BY od.ENT_CODE,od.MASTER_OD_JOB_NO, ad.SIMPLE_DOC_NO
HAVING od.MASTER_OD_JOB_NO = #{masterOdJobNo}
GROUP BY od.ENT_CODE,od.MASTER_OD_JOB_NO
) B WHERE B.POD_CNT = 0

,(SELECT NAME_${userLanguage} FROM TB_SMS_CODE_DETAIL WHERE ENT_CODE = od.ENT_CODE AND CODE = od.CD_TYPE AND GROUP_CODE = 'CD_TYPE') AS CD_TYPE_NAME ,(SELECT CONCAT(CODE, '.', NAME_${userLanguage}) FROM TB_SMS_CODE_DETAIL WHERE ENT_CODE = od.ENT_CODE AND CODE = od.CD_USE_TYPE AND GROUP_CODE = 'USE_GUBN') AS CD_USE_TYPE_NAME ,(SELECT CONCAT(CODE, '.', NAME_${userLanguage}) FROM TB_SMS_CODE_DETAIL WHERE ENT_CODE = od.ENT_CODE AND CODE = od.ECM_TYPE AND GROUP_CODE = 'CCL_ECOMMERCE_TYPE') AS ECM_TYPE_NAME ,(SELECT CONCAT(CODE, '.', NAME_${userLanguage}) FROM TB_SMS_CODE_DETAIL WHERE ENT_CODE = od.ENT_CODE AND CODE = od.CUSTOMS_ID_TYPE AND GROUP_CODE = 'CUSTOMS_ID_TYPE') AS CUSTOMS_ID_TYPE_NAME ,(SELECT CONCAT(CODE, '.', NAME_${userLanguage}) FROM TB_SMS_CODE_DETAIL WHERE ENT_CODE = od.ENT_CODE AND CODE = ad.INSPECTION_APP_CODE AND GROUP_CODE = 'SE_INSPECTION_CODE') AS INSPECTION_APP_CODE ,(SELECT NAME_${userLanguage} FROM TB_SMS_CODE_DETAIL WHERE ENT_CODE = od.ENT_CODE AND GROUP_CODE = 'STATUS_ORDER_CARGO' AND CODE = ad.LAST_POD_STATUS) AS LAST_POD_STATUS_NAME ,od.CD_TYPE ,od.CD_USE_TYPE ,od.ECM_TYPE ,od.CUSTOMS_ID_TYPE ,ad.LAST_POD_STATUS

,STUFF((SELECT '-' + ABNORMAL_CODE FROM TB_ECM_OD_ABNORMAL WHERE OD_JOB_NO = od.OD_JOB_NO ORDER BY REGISTER_DATE_TIME FOR XML PATH('')), 1, 1, '') AS ABNORMAL_CODE ,od.PENALTY_YN ,CASE WHEN (SELECT TOP 1 REFERENCE_NO_ID FROM TB_COM_FILE_SHARE WHERE ENT_CODE = od.ENT_CODE AND FUNC_JOB_NO = od.OD_JOB_NO ) IS NULL THEN 'N' ELSE 'Y' END AS FILE_SHARE
,ad.SIMPLE_REPORT_DATE ,ad.SIMPLE_STATEMENT_YN ,ad.SIMPLE_STATEMENT_REASON

mapper.insert: /* ManifestMapper.insertEmsOdChg : 특성오더생성 */ INSERT INTO TB_COM_OD_CHG_INVOICE( OD_JOB_NO ,CHARGE_SEQ_NO ,SOLUTION ,LOCAL_OVERSEA ,CHARGE_CODE ,CHARGE_NAME ,CURRENCY_CODE_CUR ,EXCHANGE_RATE ,CURRENCY_CODE_LOC ,EXRATE_USD ,RATE_MULTIPLY ,CHG_PROFIT_TYPE ,INV_PREPAID_YN ,RATE_QTY_WT ,PAY_FOR_YN ,VAT_YNX ,AFC_YN ,INVOICE_BUS_CODE ,AR_AP ,ACCOUNT_CODE ,INVOICE_TARGET_YN ,MBL_JOB_NO ,BL_NO ,CHG_PS_TYPE )VALUES( #{odJobNo} ,CONCAT(#{odJobNo}, '-0001') ,'EMS' ,'LOCAL' ,#{chargeCode} ,#{chargeName} ,#{arCurrencyCode} ,#{arExrate} ,#{currencyCodeLoc} ,#{exrateUsd} ,'B/L' ,'F' ,'N' ,1 ,'N' ,'N' ,'Y' ,#{entBusinessCode} ,'AR' ,#{consigneeCode} ,'Y' ,#{mblJobNo} ,#{blNo} ,'ALL_CWT' )

/* ManifestMapper.selectCustomsManifestCancelMaster : 통관목록취하신고 마스터조회 - ${action} */ SELECT od.CUSTOMS_CODE ,od.CUSTOMS_DPT_CODE ,od.OB_DATE ,od.OB_TIME ,od.VOYAGE ,od.VESSEL_FLIGHT ,od.MRN ,od.MSN ,od.DEST_COUNTRY ,od.DEST_CODE ,od.BOUND ,od.BOUND_TYPE ,od.MBL_NO ,od.AR_DATE ,od.ORIG_CODE ,ad.CARRYOUT_CODE ,CASE WHEN ISNULL(ad.CARRYOUT_CODE,'') = 'GG' OR ISNULL(ad.CARRYOUT_CODE,'') = 'FF' THEN '02' ELSE '01' END AS DECLARE_TYPE ,CONVERT(VARCHAR(8), ad.SIMPLE_DOC_DATE, 112) AS SIMPLE_DOC_DATE ,od.ENT_CODE ,od.ENT_BUSINESS_CODE ,od.DEST_PORT ,od.OD_JOB_NO ,ad.EDI_MAILBOX_SEQ_NO ,( SELECT TOP 1 A.POD_JOB_NO FROM( SELECT POD_JOB_NO FROM TB_ECM_POD WHERE OD_JOB_NO = od.OD_JOB_NO AND POD_STATUS = 'ECM131' UNION ALL SELECT POD_JOB_NO FROM TB_ECM_POD_02 WHERE OD_JOB_NO = od.OD_JOB_NO AND POD_STATUS = 'ECM131' ) A ) AS ECM131_POD_JOB_NO ,( SELECT TOP 1 A.POD_JOB_NO FROM( SELECT POD_JOB_NO FROM TB_ECM_POD WHERE OD_JOB_NO = od.OD_JOB_NO AND POD_STATUS = 'ECM134' UNION ALL SELECT POD_JOB_NO FROM TB_ECM_POD_02 WHERE OD_JOB_NO = od.OD_JOB_NO AND POD_STATUS = 'ECM134' ) A ) AS ECM134_POD_JOB_NO
,od.LINE_CODE
,od.ASSIGNMENT_WH_CODE ,(SELECT COUNT(OD_JOB_NO) FROM TB_ECM_OD WHERE MASTER_OD_JOB_NO = #{masterOdJobNo} AND BL_TYPE_MH = 'H' AND CD_TYPE = 'Y') AS HBL_CNT ,od.SELECTOR_USER_NAME ,od.CONFIRMER_USER_NAME
,(SELECT ETC1 FROM TB_SMS_CODE_DETAIL WHERE ENT_CODE = od.ENT_CODE AND GROUP_CODE = 'EDI_BONDED_WAREHOUSE' AND CODE = od.ASSIGNMENT_WH_CODE) AS ASSIGNMENT_WH_CODE_ETC ,(SELECT MAX(B2G_FORWARDER_SIGN) FROM TB_SMS_ENT_BUS_FMS WHERE ENT_CODE = od.ENT_CODE) AS B2G_FORWARDER_SIGN
,( SELECT COUNT(tb1.OD_JOB_NO) FROM TB_ECM_OD tb1 INNER JOIN TB_ECM_OD_ADDITIONAL tb2 ON tb2.OD_JOB_NO = tb1.OD_JOB_NO WHERE tb1.ENT_CODE = houseOd.ENT_CODE AND tb1.MASTER_OD_JOB_NO = houseOd.MASTER_OD_JOB_NO AND tb2.SIMPLE_DOC_NO = houseAd.SIMPLE_DOC_NO AND tb1.BL_TYPE_MH = 'H' AND tb1.BL_TYPE_IERT NOT IN('T', 'R') AND tb1.CD_TYPE = 'Y' AND (tb2.SIMPLE_DROP_EDI_STATUS IS NULL OR tb2.SIMPLE_DROP_EDI_STATUS = 'ERROR') ) AS SIMPLE_DOC_NO_CNT ,houseAd.SIMPLE_DOC_NO AS SIMPLE_DOC_NO_LIST
,( SELECT STUFF((SELECT ',' + tb3.SIMPLE_DOC_NO FROM ( SELECT tb2.SIMPLE_DOC_NO FROM TB_ECM_OD tb1 INNER JOIN TB_ECM_OD_ADDITIONAL tb2 ON tb2.OD_JOB_NO = tb1.OD_JOB_NO WHERE tb1.ENT_CODE = od.ENT_CODE AND tb1.MASTER_OD_JOB_NO = od.MASTER_OD_JOB_NO AND tb2.SIMPLE_DOC_NO != '' AND tb2.SIMPLE_DOC_NO IS NOT NULL AND tb1.BL_TYPE_MH = 'H' AND tb1.BL_TYPE_IERT NOT IN('T', 'R') AND tb1.CD_TYPE = 'Y' AND (tb2.SIMPLE_DROP_EDI_STATUS IS NULL OR tb2.SIMPLE_DROP_EDI_STATUS = 'ERROR')
AND tb2.SIMPLE_DOC_NO IN (#{item})
GROUP BY tb2.SIMPLE_DOC_NO ) tb3 FOR XML PATH('')), 1, 1, '') ) AS SIMPLE_DOC_NO_LIST
,(SELECT EDI_PORTAL_MAILBOX_ID FROM TB_SMS_ENT_BUS_EDI_ECM WHERE ENT_CODE = od.ENT_CODE AND ENT_BUSINESS_CODE = od.ENT_BUSINESS_CODE AND SEQ_NO = ad.EDI_MAILBOX_SEQ_NO) AS EDI_PORTAL_MAILBOX_ID
FROM TB_ECM_OD od INNER JOIN TB_ECM_OD_ADDITIONAL ad ON ad.OD_JOB_NO = od.OD_JOB_NO
WHERE od.OD_JOB_NO = #{masterOdJobNo}
FROM TB_ECM_OD houseOd INNER JOIN TB_ECM_OD od ON od.OD_JOB_NO = houseOd.MASTER_OD_JOB_NO
INNER JOIN TB_ECM_OD_ADDITIONAL houseAd ON houseAd.OD_JOB_NO = houseOd.OD_JOB_NO
INNER JOIN TB_ECM_OD_ADDITIONAL ad ON ad.OD_JOB_NO = od.OD_JOB_NO
WHERE houseOd.OD_JOB_NO = #{odJobNo}

/* ManifestMapper.selectCustomsManifestCancelHouseItem : 통관목록취하신고 하우스 오더, 세부품목 조회 - ${action} */ SELECT
COUNT(od.OD_JOB_NO) AS COUNT_CHECK
od.GWT ,od.PIECES ,od.PIECES_REAL ,od.COMMODITY_ITEM ,od.SHIPPER_NAME ,od.SHIPPER_COUNTRY_CODE ,dbo.Cryptography(od.OD_JOB_NO, od.SHIPPER_BUSINESS_ID, 1) AS SHIPPER_BUSINESS_ID ,CASE WHEN ISNULL(od.SHIPPER_HP, '') = '' THEN od.SHIPPER_TEL ELSE od.SHIPPER_HP END AS SHIPPER_TEL ,CONCAT(ISNULL(od.SHIPPER_ADDRESS, ''), ISNULL(od.SHIPPER_ADDRESS_A, ''), ISNULL(od.SHIPPER_ADDRESS_B, ''), ISNULL(od.SHIPPER_ADDRESS_C, ''), ISNULL(od.SHIPPER_ADDRESS_D, '')) AS SHIPPER_ADDRESS ,od.CONSIGNEE_NAME ,CONCAT(ISNULL(od.CONSIGNEE_ADDRESS, ''), ISNULL(od.CONSIGNEE_ADDRESS_A, ''), ISNULL(od.CONSIGNEE_ADDRESS_B, ''), ISNULL(od.CONSIGNEE_ADDRESS_C, ''), ISNULL(od.CONSIGNEE_ADDRESS_D, '')) AS CONSIGNEE_ADDRESS ,od.CONSIGNEE_ZIPCODE ,od.HBL_NO ,od.HSN ,od.CONSIGNEE_NAME_LOC ,od.CONSIGNEE_ADDRESS_LOC ,od.ECM_TYPE ,od.OD_JOB_NO ,od.CUSTOMS_ID_TYPE ,od.CD_USE_TYPE ,od.AMOUNT_LOC ,od.AMOUNT_USD ,od.ALLOWED_ITEM_CODE ,ad.SIMPLE_DOC_NO ,od.AGENT_REG_NO ,od.INSPECTION_YN ,od.URL ,od.ECM_BUY_TYPE ,od.SELLER_REG_NO ,od.SELLER_NAME ,od.AGENT_REG_NO ,od.AGENT_NAME ,od.SALES_BROKER_REG_NO ,od.SALES_BROKER_NAME ,od.CUSTOMS_CODE ,od.CUSTOMS_DPT_CODE ,od.ORIG_CODE ,od.GOODS_LOC_CODE ,od.GOODS_LOC_ADDR ,od.BWH_NAME ,od.GOODS_LOC_INSPECT_YN ,od.GOODS_LOC_INSPECT_REASON
,ISNULL((SELECT COUNT(OD_JOB_NO) FROM TB_ECM_OD_ITEM WHERE OD_JOB_NO = od.OD_JOB_NO), 1) AS ITEM_CNT ,ad.SIMPLE_DOC_DATE
,(SELECT TOP 1 EDI_PORTAL_MAILBOX_ID FROM TB_SMS_ENT_BUS_EDI_ECM WHERE ENT_CODE = od.ENT_CODE AND ENT_BUSINESS_CODE = od.ENT_BUSINESS_CODE AND BOUND = od.BOUND AND EDI_CITY_PORT = od.ORIG_CODE ORDER BY SEQ_NO) AS EDI_PORTAL_MAILBOX_ID
,od.URL ,( SELECT TOP 1 A.POD_JOB_NO FROM( SELECT POD_JOB_NO FROM TB_ECM_POD WHERE OD_JOB_NO = od.OD_JOB_NO AND POD_STATUS = 'ECM131' UNION ALL SELECT POD_JOB_NO FROM TB_ECM_POD_02 WHERE OD_JOB_NO = od.OD_JOB_NO AND POD_STATUS = 'ECM131' ) A ) AS ECM131_POD_JOB_NO ,( SELECT TOP 1 A.POD_JOB_NO FROM( SELECT POD_JOB_NO FROM TB_ECM_POD WHERE OD_JOB_NO = od.OD_JOB_NO AND POD_STATUS = 'ECM134' UNION ALL SELECT POD_JOB_NO FROM TB_ECM_POD_02 WHERE OD_JOB_NO = od.OD_JOB_NO AND POD_STATUS = 'ECM134' ) A ) AS ECM134_POD_JOB_NO ,ad.LAST_POD_STATUS
,'[' + STUFF(( SELECT ',{DETAIL_ITEM_NAME:"' + ISNULL(REPLACE(DETAIL_ITEM_NAME, '"',''), '') + '",UNIT_PIECES:"' + ISNULL(UNIT_PIECES, '1') + '",PIECES:"' + CAST(CAST(ISNULL(PIECES,1) AS INT) AS VARCHAR) + '",AMOUNT:"' + CAST(CONVERT(DECIMAL(11,2), AMOUNT) AS VARCHAR) + '",BRAND:"' + ISNULL(BRAND, '') + '"}' FROM TB_ECM_OD_ITEM items WHERE od.OD_JOB_NO = items.OD_JOB_NO ORDER BY items.SEQ_NO_ID FOR XML PATH ('') ) + ']', 1, 1, '') AS itemsInfo ,'[' + STUFF(( SELECT ',"' + ISNULL(REPLACE(PO_NO, '"',''), '') + '"' FROM TB_ECM_OD_PO_INFO poInfo WHERE od.OD_JOB_NO = poInfo.OD_JOB_NO FOR XML PATH ('') ) + ']', 1, 1, '') AS poInfo ,od.PO_NO ,ad.DROP_YN
,CASE WHEN ISNULL(od.CONSIGNEE_HP_ENC, '') = '' THEN dbo.Cryptography(od.OD_JOB_NO, od.CONSIGNEE_TEL_ENC, 1) ELSE dbo.Cryptography(od.OD_JOB_NO, od.CONSIGNEE_HP_ENC, 1) END AS CONSIGNEE_TEL ,dbo.Cryptography(od.OD_JOB_NO, od.CUSTOMS_ID_ENC, 1) AS CUSTOMS_ID
,CASE WHEN ISNULL(od.CONSIGNEE_HP, '') = '' THEN od.CONSIGNEE_TEL ELSE od.CONSIGNEE_HP END AS CONSIGNEE_TEL ,od.CUSTOMS_ID
FROM TB_ECM_OD od INNER JOIN TB_ECM_OD_ADDITIONAL ad ON ad.OD_JOB_NO = od.OD_JOB_NO
WHERE od.MASTER_OD_JOB_NO = #{masterOdJobNo}
WHERE od.OD_JOB_NO IN(#{item})
AND od.BL_TYPE_MH = 'H' AND od.BL_TYPE_IERT NOT IN('T', 'R') AND od.CD_TYPE = 'Y' AND ISNULL(ad.SIMPLE_DROP_EDI_STATUS,'ERROR') = 'ERROR'
AND ad.SIMPLE_DOC_NO = #{simpleDocNo}
AND ISNULL(ad.SIMPLE_DOC_NO,'') != ''
ORDER BY EDI_PORTAL_MAILBOX_ID, od.OD_JOB_NO
ORDER BY od.OD_JOB_NO
OFFSET ${startNum} ROWS FETCH NEXT ${houseCount} ROWS ONLY

/* ManifestMapper.deleteDropHist : 취하이력삭제 (하우스 체크건 DROP_YN을 N으로 변경) */ UPDATE ad SET ad.DROP_YN = 'N'
,ad.DROP_CODE = CASE WHEN ISNULL(ad.DROP_CODE, '') != '00' THEN NULL ELSE ad.DROP_CODE END FROM TB_ECM_OD od INNER JOIN TB_ECM_OD_ADDITIONAL ad ON ad.OD_JOB_NO = od.OD_JOB_NO WHERE od.OD_JOB_NO IN(#{item}) AND od.BL_TYPE_MH = 'H' AND ad.DROP_YN = 'Y'

/* ManifestMapper.updateResetSendCustomsManifestCancelInfo : 목록신고취하 개별초기화 */ UPDATE ad SET ad.SIMPLE_DROP_EDI_STATUS = NULL ,ad.SIMPLE_DROP_CODE = NULL ,ad.SIMPLE_DROP_ETC = NULL ,ad.SIMPLE_DROP_TIME = NULL ,ad.SIMPLE_DROP_RESULT_DATE = NULL ,ad.SIMPLE_DROP_ERROR_DESC = NULL ,ad.SIMPLE_DROP_AUTH_NAME = NULL ,ad.SIMPLE_DROP_AUTH_CODE = NULL ,ad.LAST_POD_STATUS = CASE WHEN od.BL_TYPE_MH = 'M' THEN #{lastPodStatusMaster} ELSE #{lastPodStatus} END FROM TB_ECM_OD od INNER JOIN TB_ECM_OD_ADDITIONAL ad ON ad.OD_JOB_NO = od.OD_JOB_NO WHERE od.OD_JOB_NO = #{odJobNo}
